name: EAS Update Preview Continuous Deployment

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  deploy-eas-preview:
    name: Build and Push Preview Bundle to EAS
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Source Code Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js Build Environment
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Setup Remote Expo EAS Command Line System
        uses: expo/expo-github-action@v8
        with:
          eas-version: latest
          token: ${{ secrets.EXPO_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install Architecture System Dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Distribute Live Iterative Preview via EAS Update Channels
        run: eas update --branch main --message "${{ github.event.head_commit.message }}"
        env:
          EXPO_PROJECT_ID: ${{ secrets.EXPO_PROJECT_ID }}
